title: Inbox One
description: An exploration of a brand new homepage view for the VS Code agents window. It implements an email style inbox view for agent sessions list and a chat composer. V1 — three-pane mail: mailbox rail (Inbox, Needs input, In progress, Pinned, Done, workspaces, groups), a session list grouped by attention and date, and a reading pane showing the session thread with inline answers and a reply composer (vsc-chat-input). New Session opens a compose view. Keys: j/k, e done, u unread, p pin, c compose, r reply, /.
